ModMetaData.name: ESCP - Dunmer Armory
ModMetaData.description: The Elder Scrolls Collaboration Project Presents: Dunmer Armory, craftable chitin and bonemold armor from Morrowind. Only Dunmer crafters can make it, and Dunmer soldiers wear it into battle. Requires ESCP - Dunmer.
